PipePrower Privacy Policy 


This Privacy policy will notify that how we collect, use, share and disclose your information. By installing the apps on your device, entering into, connecting to, accessing and/or using the apps, you agree to this privacy policy and give an explicit and informed consent to the processing. If you do not agree to this privacy policy, please uninstall and do not use this apps.


What information we use

This sound meter app use your 'RECORD AUDIO FEATURES' that can be associated with your non-personal information.


How we use this information

We use record audio feature to make sound meter's decibel value.


Rest information

We may collect, use, share and disclose below information to provide you with a safe, efficient and customized experience and to provide you with services and features that better meet your needs or requests.

We may collect, use and share non-personal information such as your device model number, operating system version, country code, Device ID, IP address and other properties. And we may disclose non-personal information to third parties and/or allow third parties to collect non-personal information through their own embedded technology. In order to deliver ads to you, the third-party advertising companies may place or recognize unique cookies, anonymous identifiers or similar technology for non-personally identifiable information.

We may use personal information to send emails to you about the apps, such as new features and services, special offers, order issues and updated information.


Contact us

If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Apps, please contact us via email at games.kkprotasov@gmail.com Capcorn Interactive Team
